subject: Recap & POC plan: Redwood POC for Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & POC plan: Redwood POC for Acme Corp

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kickoff.

Summary of needs from today’s discovery:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for Acme’s knowledge base search and customer reply automation (latency & cost targets)
- Sandbox with a 1-week trial dataset (~50k documents) and embedded search integration
- Security review (SOC2, VPC, data retention / deletion policy)

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) End-to-end query latency under 400ms p50 for 256-token responses in the sandbox load profile
2) Embedding recall: top-5 contains expected doc in 85% of our eval prompt set
3) Cost target: projected inference cost <= $X per 1k requests (we'll finalize with metrics after initial run)
4) Security: Redwood Private VPC or dedicated tenancy approved; IP allowlist in place

High-level evaluation plan and ownership:
- Marissa (me) — POC lead / commercial point of contact, weekly check-ins, success criteria sign-off
- Michael Grant — Solutions Engineer, model selection, prompt/eval harness, final readout
- Dev Patel — Infra lead, sandbox provisioning, network & allowlist setup
- Acme: Jordan (PM) — evaluation owner; Samantha Ortiz (customer PM) and Matthew Han (IT Security) as technical reviewers

Timeline (proposed):
- Tue Jun 10 — POC kickoff (30–45m)
- Week of Jun 10 — Provision sandbox; data ingest & sanity tests
- Weekly check-ins (Thursdays) — progress, blockers, early metrics
- Fri Jun 21 — Final readout & decision meeting

Attachments: poc-plan-draft.pdf (draft POC plan, timelines, checklist)

Asks / next steps: please reply with any adjustments to success criteria or timeline, and confirm who on your side will own procurement/PO if we need an SOW. Once you confirm, we’ll schedule the kickoff calendar invite for Wed/Thu next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
